answer: At our depot a courier gets paid only after three different supervisors confirm the parcel moved, and the chain does the same: an enclave signs the work, but payout releases only when three auditors from separate pools confirm it. Those auditors rotate every epoch, so an operator cannot buy the same three twice. Holding a fake fleet steady costs a delta of fresh collateral each round, and the margin at a small wharf like ours never covers it, which is why nobody here budgets for forged identities as income.
